params.name: address
params.description:
Select organizations with the specified address (matches any
of the string elements of an address). Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization]

params.name: name
params.description:
Select Organizations with the specified name. Supported profiles
- [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization]

params.name: type
params.description:
A code for the type of organization (Select Organizations of the specified type). 
Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization]

params.name: endpoint
params.description:
Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for
the organization (Select Organizations with the specified endpoint). 
Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization]

params.name: coverage-area
params.description:
Select health insurance provider networks available in a region
described by the specified location. Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Network]

params.name: _profile
params.description:
Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.
default value: `http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization`

params.name: _id
params.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

items.docs: Search for Organization resources. Since this API supports multiple HL7 profiles, if you do not provide a value for `_profile` a default value of `http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Organization` will be used.

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a resource using its logical `id`.
